name: FREE DUNK
detailed_description:
Dev Letter

These scenes are all too real for basketball lovers: the sting of a finger jab during a steal, a star player nailing a massive triple-double and capturing everyone's admiration, the explosion of chatter in a fan group when a trade hits the news, and the heated debates over who currently holds the title of the best shooting guard in the league. In "FREE DUNK," we strive to encapsulate these passionate and exhilarating moments in every pixel.

Yet, creating this experience is infinitely more complex than mastering a crossover move back in the day. Beyond our passion for the game, we need to sharpen our 'inner skills': the game must be intuitive and smooth, the art style unique with striking character models. The player development system should be rich and varied, enabling you to build your own superstar. A balanced and orderly game ecosystem is crucial to ensure everyone can compete fairly. These challenges are our primary focus, and we know that every basketball journey starts with airballs and missed backboards.

As we approach the upcoming game test, anticipation is mixed with a touch of anxiety. We understand that "FREE DUNK," from its initial idea to its current form, will undergo countless revisions and refinements. We're ready for that. Believe us when we say that this dedicated team will never stop improving the game. The harsh critiques from the community, the cries of "this feature is brutal" on live streams, and even the optimization suggestions sent at three in the morning will all be noted and displayed on our 'wall of shame' in the office. After all, only true friends on the streetball court will candidly say, "Buddy, you've got a long way to go."

Without realizing it, basketball has seeped into our very being, becoming an integral part of who we are.

—— THE 'FREE DUNK' TEAM


About the Game

The official version is anticipated to launch in the second half of 2025

We're a team of "old boys" with twenty years of basketball game development under our belts, and this time, we're doing something different. More than just a competitive game, we're building an ideal world of culture, dreams, and passion. We'll pour everything into it and never give up.

Our journey never stops, no matter when the official version launches. Just like a full-intensity game before the final whistle, we'll keep refining and optimizing, growing with your feedback. That "final whistle" never sounds if we don't quit. So, we'll keep pushing forward, ensuring every FREE DUNK evolution earns your love and anticipation!

Train Your Superstars: Your Streets, Your Legend

You're the architect of your players' growth. From rookie to street king, you plan every step: training, real matches, skill development – complete control. Unleash their potential, forge true all-rounders. A 1.6-meter guard faking out defenders, a 2.15-meter center with fancy dribbling – height and position don't limit here. The stars you shape will redefine street basketball.

PVE Advancement Challenges: Sharpen Skills, Earn Your Glory

Our PVE mode features seasonal updates, offering a long-term challenge for passionate players. Victory isn't just stats; it's about your skill, strategy, and growth. Lead your team from community tournaments to the global stage, earning rewards that mark your players' transformation. Every match is practice, every season a growth journey. Advance by skill, conquering challenges to reach the streetball peak!

PVP Confrontation: Global Dreams&Player-Hosted Matches

Jump into Quick Match for team play and individual flair. We're planning "small cooperative events" to help you and your teammates win key games. Accumulate points in PVP to reach the annual "Global Finals," competing against top players worldwide.

Plus, our "Custom Match" system is constantly improving. Soon, you'll host your own matches, setting rules and inviting friends to create your ultimate street basketball spectacle.

Smooth Controls, Pure Streetball Fun, Rekindled

FREE DUNK is dedicated to creating a responsive, fluid, and intuitive control experience, aiming to recreate those electrifying real-life moments: dream shakes, one-legged fades, Euro steps, sudden pull-up jumpers...you can pull them all off yourself! Unstoppable threes, deceptive crossovers, signature combos—everything's in your hands. We've kept the controls easy to learn and quick to master, yet with vast room for advanced play. Coupled with a replay function, every highlight moment is worth saving and sharing!

Forge a Free Ecosystem: Everyone's a Dream Weaver

In the world of FREE DUNK, basketball isn't just a sport; it's a form of expression. Every player can find their place: be a technical wizard, constantly pushing limits in intense matchups; be a manager, training star players and building champion teams; or even be a creator, helping design and co-create trendy content like outfits and items. Basketball is more than just games here. This is a utopia for enthusiasts, and no matter who you are, you can shine brightly on this stage.

short_description: "FREE DUNK" immerses you in street basketball, celebrating individuality and competition. Build your legend, craft a dream team, and join global streetball leagues. Experience the raw joy of the game with controller support—hit the streets for epic battles!
supported_languages: English, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Simplified Chinese
